snippet.title: Godreaper — Slavic Dark Fantasy Action-Adventure | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⚔️ *Wishlist Godreaper on Steam* - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2691080/Godreaper/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=godreaper

Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure set in a world inspired by East Slavic mythology.

Play as the bogatyr Zaremire, explore a dying land corrupted by a mysterious force, fight creatures from Navi and face powerful gods driven mad by the decay spreading through the roots of the World Tree.

Godreaper is coming to PC via Steam in 2027.
